questions.cardText:
[Chemistry] What color does blue litmus paper turn when it comes into contact with an acid?
A. Red
B. Purple
C. It stays blue
Answer: A. Litmus paper was first used in the 1300s, making it one of the oldest forms of pH indicators used to test acidity and alkalinity.
questions.de: Welche Farbe nimmt blaues Lackmuspapier an, wenn es mit einer Säure in Berührung kommt?
questions.en: What colour does blue litmus paper turn when it comes into contact with an acid?

timeline.labelEn: Catalan physician Arnaldus de Villa Nova begins using litmus to study acids and bases
timeline.labelDe: Der katalanische Arzt Arnaldus de Villa Nova verwendet Lackmus zur Untersuchung von Säuren und Basen

questions.notes: Card correct; Wikipedia dates first use of litmus to circa 1300 (Arnaldus de Villa Nova).

questions.cardText:
[Zoology] Which one of the following species does NOT pair-bond?
A. Prairie vole
B. Bald eagle
C. Grizzly bear
Answer: C. Unlike bald eagles and prairie voles, which are known for forming long-term monogamous pair bonds, grizzly bears typically have solitary lives outside of the mating season.
questions.de: Anders als Weißkopfseeadler und Präriewühlmäuse gehen Grizzlybären keine dauerhaften Paarbindungen ein – wie leben sie außerhalb der Paarungszeit typischerweise?
questions.en: Unlike bald eagles and prairie voles, grizzly bears form no lasting pair bonds – how do they typically live outside the mating season?

timeline.labelEn: George Ord describes the grizzly bear as Ursus horribilis
timeline.labelDe: George Ord beschreibt den Grizzlybären als Ursus horribilis

questions.notes: 'Which does NOT' reworked to the positive fact: Wikipedia says grizzlies are normally solitary (gathering only at salmon runs).
